_comment: Canonical Aether metric registry — DO NOT manually edit. Source of truth for packages/shared/measurement-contract.ts, Backend Architecture/aether-backend/shared/measurement/generated_registry.py, and docs/_generated/metric-registry-table.md. Mirrors the hand-authored shared/measurement/registry.py; keep the two in lockstep (tests/unit/test_metric_registry_contract.py enforces parity). Edit here, then run: python scripts/generate_contracts.py

metrics.name: attributed_conversions
metrics.description: Conversions credited under the active attribution model.

metrics.name: campaign_cac
metrics.description: Customer acquisition cost for a campaign.

metrics.name: campaign_ltv
metrics.description: Customer lifetime value attributed to a campaign.

metrics.name: campaign_roas
metrics.description: Return on ad spend for a campaign.

metrics.name: campaign_spend
metrics.description: Media and allocated cost spent on a campaign.

metrics.name: conversion_rate
metrics.description: Share of journeys that reached a conversion.

metrics.name: costs
metrics.description: Total costs incurred over the measurement window.

metrics.name: email_click_rate
metrics.description: Share of delivered campaign messages with a qualified click.

metrics.name: email_open_rate
metrics.description: Share of delivered campaign messages with a qualified open.

metrics.name: email_reply_rate
metrics.description: Share of delivered campaign messages with a human reply.

metrics.name: exposure
metrics.description: Observed economic exposure over the measurement window.

metrics.name: gross_value
metrics.description: Gross economic value observed over the window.

metrics.name: journey_completion_rate
metrics.description: Share of started journeys that completed.

metrics.name: ltv
metrics.description: Customer lifetime value over the measurement window.

metrics.name: machine_event_rate
metrics.description: Share of campaign communication events classified as machine generated.

metrics.name: margin
metrics.description: Profit margin ratio over the measurement window.

metrics.name: net_value
metrics.description: Net economic value observed over the window.

metrics.name: refunds
metrics.description: Refunds issued over the measurement window.

metrics.name: revenue
metrics.description: Attributed revenue over the measurement window.

metrics.name: touchpoints
metrics.description: Distinct marketing touchpoints observed in the window.
